notes:
Workin Title is now Underneath, and this is its public beta. Found a bug or have an idea? Send it straight from the app: Help → Report a Bug or Idea.

New: Help → Report a Bug or Idea sends your report to the developer (if you’re offline, it goes the next time Underneath opens)
New: Settings → App icon: Mono, Colour, Light, Dark, or Match the theme
New: Languages in Settings: your two typing languages and Google spelling in one place
New: After an update, a What’s new screen shows what changed
New: Help → Beta Licence: the beta is free to keep; testers who send useful reports get Underneath 1 free
Changed: The app’s new name is Underneath; your projects and settings stay as they were
Changed: A new app icon
Changed: Smarter spelling from Google is off until you turn it on in Settings (it sends the words you type to Google)
Changed: Coloured beats fill the whole card on boards too, as on outlines
Changed: English is the only language until you pick a second one
Changed: The language list is sorted A to Z by region
Changed: The timeline starts closed
Changed: The update window shows the main changes, with Show all changes for the rest
Fixed: The three bars of the timeline button are equally thick at every interface size
Fixed: Colouring a column in outlines and boards now shows, half see-through
Fixed: Transparent PNG images keep their transparency on boards
